name: io.github.CyberPunk11147/cyberwarex-council
description: Second opinion for an agent: 3-4 different AI models answer one question, chair returns verdict + confidence + dissent.

environmentVariables.name: CWX_X_PAYMENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional x402 X-PAYMENT header. If unset, the server opts into the free trial and then surfaces the 402 invoice to the agent so its own x402 client can pay and retry.

environmentVariables.name: CWX_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional prepaid credit key (cwx_...) from https://safe.cyberwarex.com/subscribe, so no per-call signing is needed.
